Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. ProcJet Ltd is a UK-based industrial procurement and supply chain company supporting the energy, oil & gas, utilities, EPC and infrastructure sectors.

We specialise in UK and European equipment sourcing, industrial materials, OEM and obsolete spare parts, specialist equipment supply and project procurement support.

We are seeking an experienced Business Development Partner to help expand our UK customer base and generate new commercial opportunities.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a commercially driven professional who can use their existing industry network to introduce ProcJet to potential customers and help convert genuine opportunities into business.

  • Solid engineering fundamentals and strong Python
